social.title: Lost Traveler
social.description: A traveler asks the party for help.
social.twist: The traveler is secretly a thief.

social.title: Merchant
social.description: Party meets a merchant named Kameleo on their way.
social.twist: Merchant did not check if sold items are cursed.

combat.title: Feral Animals
combat.description: Feral and starving animals attack the party.
combat.twist: Combat can be omitet if animals are given food.
combat.reward: Gold can be found in one of creature's stomach.

combat.title: Blind Orc
combat.description: Blind orc charges at the party and swings axe violently.
combat.reward: If team quiets down and follows the orc, it will lead the party to it's hideout with treasure.

hazard.title: Fungi Spores
hazard.description: One party member steps accidentally on innocentky looking fungi. It shoots spores and temporarly poisons party.

hazard.title: Tiles Falling Down
hazard.description: Party member steps on a tile and one row of tiles falls down to reveal a big hole.

puzzle.title: Sphinx
puzzle.description: The party encounters a Sphinx. They are asked three questions, if they answer, they can go further.

puzzle.title: Magic Door
puzzle.description: A magical door blocks the passage. It has five buttons.
puzzle.twist: Buttons have to be clicked in a good order.
